source.title: Long-Term Outcomes With Nivolumab Plus Ipilimumab or Nivolumab Alone Versus Ipilimumab in Patients With Advanced Melanoma

extraction_limitations: The Drive folder contained only the main 13-page article PDF. The article-linked Data Supplement and Protocol were not present.
Some full trial design details and baseline characteristics are referenced to earlier CheckMate 067 publications or the unavailable Data Supplement rather than repeated in this report.
Updated detailed treatment-related and immune-mediated adverse-event tables are in the unavailable Data Supplement, so this extraction does not fabricate those rates.
Nivolumab plus ipilimumab versus nivolumab analyses are descriptive and the trial was not powered for that formal comparison.
schema_gaps: The schema has no native representation for a median that is not reached, so those results are retained as qualitative_result atoms rather than assigning a numeric estimate.
The schema has no dedicated field for study registration; NCT01844505 is represented as atom_kind=other.
